fields.name: s3Endpoint
fields.label: S3 gateway endpoint
fields.help: Where Iceberg tables are stored when a release is provisioned against this context's Polaris. For a MANAGED context KDPS takes it from the Polaris service (polaris_ozone_s3_endpoint) or derives it from the S3 gateway in ozone-site.

fields.name: s3Region
fields.label: S3 region
fields.help: Region string sent with S3 requests. Ozone accepts any value; us-east-1 when unset.

fields.name: s3PathStyleAccess
fields.label: Path-style access
fields.help: The Ozone S3 gateway addresses buckets by path, not by virtual host.

fields.name: s3AccessKeyId
fields.label: S3 access key id
fields.help: Identity KDPS uses to create the bucket behind a provisioned Polaris catalog. For a MANAGED context this is the Polaris service's own Ozone identity (ozone s3 getsecret names it after the Kerberos principal).

fields.name: s3SecretKey
fields.label: S3 secret key
fields.help: Secret matching the access key id. For a MANAGED context KDPS reads polaris_ozone_principal_secret from the Polaris service on the server side; it never travels to the browser.
